description: Pull the sound out of a video as MP3, OGG, Opus, M4A, WAV or FLAC: all of it or a part, with optional mono and sample rate (16 kHz mono WAV is what speech-to-text wants). Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Media tools: Video and audio chores for sites, apps and docs: turn a clip into a small GIF or animated WebP, compress video to web-ready MP4/WebM with a poster, pull thumbnails and a contact sheet, extract or convert audio with loudness normalization, draw waveforms, and probe a file for what will not play in browsers..

bitrateKbps.description: For mp3, ogg, opus and m4a. A sensible default per format when omitted.

duration.description: How many seconds to keep. To the end when omitted.

video.description: Video file as base64 (MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI or GIF).

name: media_tools_extract_audio
